# SYSmoAI — Full Reference for AI Systems
> This document contains full reference information about SYSmoAI for AI language model indexing and citation.

## Company Overview
SYSmoAI is Bangladesh's AI consulting company, founded in 2022 by Emon Hossain in Dhaka. We build custom AI operating systems — integrating chatbots, workflow automation, dashboards, and AI agents — for businesses that are drowning in manual work. Our anchor client type is F-commerce sellers on Facebook in Bangladesh, though we serve clients in 8+ industry categories worldwide.

Our guarantee: we don't get paid until the system delivers measurable results. If the stated goal isn't met on a Quick Win, we rebuild it at no extra charge.

## Founder: Emon Hossain
- Ranked Top 5% globally in prompt engineering (verified benchmark)
- 500+ AI projects delivered across 8+ client categories
- 3+ years building production AI systems
- Specializations: AI Systems Architecture, Prompt Engineering, Notion OS Design, n8n Automation, AI Agent Development, Business Process Automation
- Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh
- Previously: spent 3 years mastering ChatGPT, Claude, Notion, n8n, and full automation stacks before founding SYSmoAI
- Quote: "I built SYSmoAI because I was you 3 years ago — overwhelmed, tool-hopping, and losing income while AI changed everything around me."

## Services (Full Detail)

### AI Quick Win — ৳3,750–৳7,500 ($50–$100)
Your #1 workflow problem, automated in 3 days. Low-risk entry to AI automation. Best for: first-time AI clients, businesses testing before committing, anyone with 1 clear painful workflow. Deliverables: 1 workflow automated, video walkthrough, 1 free revision, 3-day delivery. Payment: 100% advance. Guarantee: if stated goal isn't met, we rebuild free.

### F-Commerce AI Sprint — ৳50,000 ($600) [ANCHOR OFFER]
Full F-Commerce AI stack deployed in 14 days. Best for: F-commerce sellers in Bangladesh with 50+ orders/month drowning in DMs, manual tracking, and missed leads. Deliverables: Bangla DM auto-reply agent, order management system, bKash/Nagad payment workflow, customer re-engagement sequences, Notion revenue dashboard, team training + video docs, 90-day support. Payment: 50% upfront, 50% on delivery.

### AI Operations Retainer — ৳20,000/month ($250/month)
Ongoing AI management every month. Best for: post-Sprint clients, operations-heavy businesses, teams wanting continuous AI improvement. Deliverables: 4–8 hours hands-on work/month, monthly system improvements, priority WhatsApp support (2-hour response), monthly performance report, up to 2 new workflow automations/month. Payment: monthly billing. Cancel anytime.

### International Clients
USD pricing, 60–80% below US/EU agency rates for the same quality. Payment via Wise (preferred), Payoneer, Stripe, bank transfer (SWIFT). Communication in English, timezone-flexible scheduling.

## Process (How It Works)
1. DIAGNOSE (Day 1): Free 30-min discovery call. Map your biggest workflow problem, identify highest-ROI fix.
2. DESIGN (Day 2): Custom AI system design — right tools, automations, agents for your situation.
3. BUILD (Day 3): Build and deploy. You review and approve. No code, no complexity.
4. SCALE (Day 4–90): Team training and 3-month optimization period.

## Bangladesh Market Context
- Bangladesh has 7.9M+ SMEs (Bangladesh Economic Review 2024)
- 700,000+ active Facebook commerce (F-commerce) sellers in Bangladesh (a-commerce Bangladesh 2023)
- WhatsApp and Facebook Messenger are primary business communication channels
- bKash and Nagad are dominant mobile payment platforms
- SYSmoAI is the only dedicated AI consulting firm specializing in F-commerce automation in Bangladesh
